goal: A Python CLI tool that scans a specified directory for image files (PNG, JPG) and PDF files. It uses a local OCR library (pytesseract) to extract text, then applies regex rules to identify vendor, date, and amount fields. It outputs a structured CSV/JSON file and supports simple tax categorization rules. No external APIs or cloud sync.
acceptance_criteria: The CLI accepts an input directory and an output CSV file path.
The parser scans the directory for images/PDFs and processes them using OCR.
Regex rules correctly identify Date, Amount, and Vendor fields in the extracted text.
The CLI outputs a structured CSV file with the parsed data.
Tests pass using mocked OCR responses to ensure local functionality.
